name: TFA - SMS API
description: Deliver two-factor authentication codes by SMS via SMS API.
project_description:
The TFA SMSAPI module integrates the TFA and SMSAPI modules to support two-step authentication by sending SMS messages delivered via the SMSAPI service. The module provides a ready-to-use solution to seamlessly add two-step verification functionality for those who want to add verification for their site, as well as those who already have the TFA module configured.

 

 Features 
 
 Sending verification codes for a user-defined telephone number in the TFA module. 
 Configurable limit on the number of codes users can enter before their account is locked. 
 Configurable selection of the message sender configured in the SMSAPI sender list to send the verification code.
